rook.said: Another one off the low Ford Road. I'm Rook, and this is the last lamp. Bed, bread, a bath, if you ask nicely. And a strong room for what you'd rather not carry about.

chid.text: Sit down, pal, and drop your trousers or don't. I've seen worse, and I've sewn worse, and I've drunk to forget the both of them.
chid.said: Sit down, pal, and drop your trousers, or don't. I've seen worse, and I've sown worse, and I've drunk to forget the both of them.

rav.said: Sit down, pal, and drop your trousers or don't. I've seen worse, and I've sown worse, and I've drunk to forget the both of them.

narrator.said: The fire has burned low. Out in the dark, the ground is moving, and somewhere ahead there is water and a cold blue light. You get up, because there is nothing else to do.

holloway.said: Eleven men, and four of them can hold a spear the right way round. I've a wall to keep, a road to keep, and a town that thinks both keep themselves.

vonnra.said: The toll is the toll. Five gold to pass east. I am Vonra. I see a great deal, Traveller, and I say very little. You will find that is the arrangement.

brannoc.said: Steel or fur? Iron's good this year. Good ore from the north before the road shut. Won't see the like again.

redcowl.said: Ha! Look at the colors on you! You're standing in my roost, and my lot are hungry, and nobody here has ever been hungry for long. Talk!

ysolde.text: Tracks by the stream, three days old. They drank, and they lay down where they drank. The Pack doesn't do that. Something in the water does.
ysolde.said: Trask by the stream. Three days old. They drank and they lay down where they drank. The pack doesn't do that. Something in the water does.

bad: accent heard as scotland (0.91), want wales
maeca.said: Trask by the stream. Three days old. They drank and they lay down where they drank. The pack doesn't do that. Something in the water does.

sella.said: Evening. Love. The lamps lit upstairs, if you're asking. Conversations extra, mind. Most people don't know they want it till they've had it.

wenna.said: Sit, child, and stop bleeding on my floor. Comfrey for the bruise, yarrow for the cut, and willow bark for the rest of you, and don't pull that face at me.

bad: accent heard as canada (0.71), want england
tam.said: Pa says stay in town, so I stayed in town. But I saw them, I did, three wolves down by the green water, and they drank and they fell down.

harlan.said: Coil Company, friend, salt, nails, lamp oil, good wool and better rope at the fairest prices between here and the coast. Ask anyone. Well, ask most people.

pell.said: Terms, friend, are what we agree they are, and I always keep to mine. Consider it a courtesy. I find courtesy is very much cheaper than the alternative.

keegan.said: Dame Keegan Ormore of the Argent Vigil, Probationary. The North Road is closed by order of the Vigil, under Chapter 2 of the Handbook, and I am obliged to explain why at some length

jory.said: I'm alright, I'm alright. Uncle keeps asking, I keep saying. It was the dark that was the worst of it.

guard.said: Keep your weapon sheathed in town. East roads that way. Mind the wolves.

guard_f.said: Gates are shut till dawn. Walk on, traveler, and keep that blade sheathed.

folk_f1.said: Bread's up again, it's always up, and rain by evening, my knee says.

folk_f2.said: Two coppers for a turnip. Two. You're not from the weigh station, are you?

folk_m1.said: Bloody wolves, bloody watch. Bloody bread, mind the cart.

folk_m2.said: my gran swore the warden was a story to keep children off the ford mourning

folk_child_f.said: Are you the one from the Ford? Did you kill it? Was it big?

folk_child_m.said: Show us your sword. Go on. Did you kill a wolf? A big one?

grimtunnel.said: Oh, what's this then? Nobody's, is it? Nobody's. Finders, keepers, surface meat.

snib.said: Snib is foreman. Snib says who goes past the pump, and Snib says nobody. The pump does not pump itself. It does, actually. But nobody.

lampling.said: Down there, under the one that is dead, there is another. There is always another.

watchman.said: It shatters its own lamps when it charges. Make it charge.

bones.said: It was never locked from the outside.

heroine.said: I woke by a dead fire on the low Ford Road. I don't know how I got there and I don't know how long I was gone. Tell me what's north.

hero.said: I woke by a dead fire on the low Ford Road. I don't know how I got there, and I don't know how long I was gone. Tell me what's north.

barrow_lord.said: Not yet. Go back. The road is shut and it is kept.

kerchief_woman.said: Then first the bairns eat, then the old ones, then us. That's how it's done here.

bad: accent heard as england (0.61), want scotland
red_hand.said: Tull's due. Same as last month and the month before. Put it in the hand and walk on.

warden_man.said: Is it morning? I kept the lamps. Someone has to keep the lamps or nobody knows where the water is.
